Pins as in the DigiMeter32 firmware (menuconfig, target esp32):
LCD SCK=D18, MOSI=D23, CS=D5, DC=D33, RST=D4 (VSPI), backlight always on;
I²C to ADS1115 SDA=D21, SCL=D22; button D27; alarm D26;
AVG/PEP switch D25. Transmit (TX) is shown on the screen.
Measurement via ADS1115 only — if it does not respond, the screen shows an ADS1115 error.
Nets with the same name (flags) are connected. THT parts, ready-made modules.
